speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Fourteen, if I counted the first arch and not the bank. This is the middle you named. I have brought the book, and I am keeping it off the grass.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This is the grass, and the grass is as far as the middle goes. The knife stays in my hand until there are three hulls.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The water is slow. It looks as if it were waiting.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Do not tell it so. A thing that has been told does not go.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then nobody tell it. Sit. One wand each, when the willow gives them. Susanna, the book stays on your knee, and dry.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: On my knee. I am not opening it until the boats are boats.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Mine first, when you cut. I have already decided the winning, and I am not saying it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou mayst decide what thou wilt. The knife has not started. Three, and then it goes back in the belt.
